propositions: The inbound probe capability (SupportsAbsenceProbe, probe_remote, inbound_probe.py, and related classifiers) has zero live callers after bug 3b5f removed its producer and dispatch arm.
Deletion is behavior-neutral and safe because deletion detection is outbound-owned and the separate outbound probe leaf remains untouched and operational.
The port must not be re-homed to binding_walk because an earlier operator ruling prohibits same-pass re-creation of confirmed-deleted issues, removing the port's original purpose.
Orphaned config keys (jira.resolved_statuses, reconciler.resolved_statuses) are deferred to a follow-up ticket as user-visible surface-change requiring separate deprecate-vs-remove decision.

Proof by both semantic search (Serena find_referencing_symbols returned empty) and repo-wide string grep (hits only in port itself, its tests, and prose) establishes the port has no production callers.
